Q = 100.

[id 142]

Wage = $10/hour.

[id 143]
Food items: Milk ($2) + Eggs ($3) = $5.
Non-food items: Light bulbs ($3) + Cups ($3) + Roach traps ($4) = $10.
Tax on non-food = 10% of $10 = $1.
Total cost = Food ($5) + Non-food ($10) + Tax ($1) = $16.

[id 144]
Clients = 3 existing + 5 potential = 8 clients.
Expenses per client = (2 * $2) + $5 = $9.
Total Expenses = 8 * $9 = $72.
Total Income = $92.
Profit = Income - Expenses = $92 - $72 = $20.

[id 145]
Pineapples per hectare = 100.
Total field = 10 hectares.
Pineapples per harvest = 1000.
Harvests per year = 12 months / 3 months = 4.
Total pineapples = 1000 * 4 = 4000.

[id 146]
Set 1 = 500 pieces.
Set 2 = "3 times more pieces than the 500 piece one". (Strict interpretation: 500 + 3*500 = 2000. Alternative colloquial: 3*500 = 1500. Given distinction with "times as many" in problem 149, strict interpretation used).
Set 2 = 2000 pieces.
Set 3 = "1/4 the number of pieces" (of Set 1) = 500 / 4 = 125.
Total = 500 + 2000 + 125 = 2625.

[id 147]
Period 1 (0-6h): 30 leave. (Outflow = 30).
Period 2 (6-12h): 1/2 return (15). (Outflow = 30 - 15 = 15).
Period 3 (12-18h): 2 * 30 = 60 leave. (Outflow = 15 + 60 = 75).
Period 4 (18-24h): All bees that hadn't returned return.
Bees left = 30 (P1) + 60 (P3) = 90.
Bees returned previously = 15.
Bees remaining out = 90 - 15 = 75.
Returns in last 6 hours = 75.
